payload.title: Where is the /goal prompt generated?
payload.body: Today a person writes the /goal prompt by hand from the tree (runs 3 to 5 of the multi-tenant tree changed it in three places only). Scenario that separates the rivals: print the prompt ten times for one fixture Goal, then print it for a Goal whose body has no valid constraints block.

why: Design question of #113, decided in the session of 2026-11-12.

payload.title: A hyp command reads the log and prints the prompt
payload.body: hyp prompt G --actor A reads the log and the Goal body and prints the prompt. The same log gives the same bytes, and a Goal without a valid block gets exit 1.

payload.title: A skill writes the prompt from the tree
payload.body: A skill reads hyp status and the Goal body, then writes the prompt as text. Its wording can differ between runs, and it has no exit code to refuse with.

payload.title: Scenarios argued in the session of 2026-11-12
payload.body: Rule, fixed before the record; scenarios S1 to S3 are in the evidence file. h-command supports if a command meets S1 to S3. h-skill contradicts if a skill fails S1 or S2. No run happened: the evidence is the session, so the tree says the question was argued, not tested.

why: Records that the owner settled q-where in the session.

payload.observation: Settled by argument in the session of 2026-11-12 with owner-standin: a command meets S1 to S3 and a skill fails S1 and S2. No run happened.

why: OWED owes this select: the only candidate, decided in the session of 2026-11-12 by owner-standin (R-HRCMSN).

payload.title: Which hyp commit implements the /goal prompt?
payload.body: The candidate is a hyp commit. The run adds each commit as a Hypothesis; a fix is a new Hypothesis that supersedes it. Scenario that separates commits: go test on the base and on each commit, against the lines of prompt-build.

why: Build question of #113; the lines of prompt-build are owed on it.

payload.summary: End of grill, 2026-11-12. prompt-design (G-227367) is complete: q-where selects h-command, decided in the session. prompt-build (G-6XTDHG) holds 8 lines and one open Question, q-commit, with no candidate yet. Nothing awaits the owner. The Goal's run prompt is hand-written: hyp prompt does not exist yet.
